thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTH anomaly detected on proxy-auth-prod-a (us-west-2). Spike in 401/429 + repeated token reuse pattern from a small IP range. Alert: https://dash.internal/alerts/7165432100
sam: oncall here, ack. looking at traces now.
mina: seeing repeated svcacct token string 'svcacct-temp-7f4a' across different customer requests, same session_id reused. could be mirrored sessions or forwarded debug logs.
ben: copying query to pull raw events
ben: ```
# kql
logs | where proxy=="proxy-auth-prod-a" and event in ("token.use","token.issue") | where ip in ("3.5.7.9","3.5.7.11") | sort by @timestamp desc
```
thomas: :lock: security — please rotate any svcacct keys that match svcacct-temp-* and create a temporary denylist for those IPs. also start KMS audit. any customer impact?
sam: running quick s3 grep on debug bucket: `aws s3 cp s3://staging-debug/proxy-a/2026-03-18-03* - | grep -E "svcacct|session_id"` — found ~12 hits, no obvious PII but headers included auth tokens.
jordan-cs: prepping customer comms template, will wait for confirmed affected list.
mina: customer-impact: two customers reporting elevated 401s and one reporting latency spikes in the last 10m. opening a CS incident and tagging them.
ben: starting a targeted rollback to previous proxy build on pool-3 to stop potential propagation. cmd: `deploy rollback proxy-auth-prod-a --to=2026-03-17_22:14` ETA ~2m.
pagerbot: Deploy job started: rolling build 2026-03-17_22:14 to 3/5 nodes.
thomas: rotate keys now: run `./scripts/rotate-svc-keys --ids "svcacct-temp-*" --ttl 1h` and push new keys to KMS. I'll take post-rotation audit.
sam: traced a forwarder id: fwdr-22 that shows an upstream debug-forwarder sending full request logs to s3://staging-debug. trace id trc_7165432115. this looks like the source of mirrored tokens. opening INC ticket INC-20260318-009.
mina: hotfix for forwarder config to strip Authorization header in flight. patched in staging, promoting to prod in 5m.
ben: rollback completed on 3/5 nodes, traffic shifting back. monitoring token-reuse metric.
pagerbot: Alert: auth anomaly rate dropping — current rate within baseline on proxy-auth-prod-a. auto-clear scheduled.
mina: follow-ups: scrub s3://staging-debug for any persisted tokens, run expunge on any objects containing auth header, coordinate with SRE for other forwarders.
jordan-cs: CS notified affected customers with initial note (no PII exposed). prepping more detailed follow-up after keys rotated and scrub complete.
leah: running `forwarder-check` playbook across all regions now, will report results.
thomas: legal notified, scheduling post-incident review (postmortem) for 16:30 PST. assigning postmortem owner: thomas.
sam: adding checklist to INC-20260318-009: timeline, rotated keys, scrubbed buckets, affected customer list, fix PRs.
mina: will coordinate a full audit of debug-forwarder configs and push stricter linting and CI gate to prevent sending auth headers in debug dumps.
ben: monitoring looks stable. closing live mitigation loop. recommend 1-hour watch with SRE.
pagerbot: Summary: root cause appears to be misconfigured debug-forwarder that mirrored auth headers to staging s3, combined with an auth proxy build that accepted mirrored sessions. Mitigations executed: forwarder config patch, targeted rollback, key rotation, s3 scrub, denylist. Next steps: postmortem, CI gate for forwarders, customer follow-ups. :spiral_note_pad:
